public.title: Find your next job
public.description: Search jobs in India and overseas from employers and recruiters checked by Venkat Sai. Applying is always free.
public.metaDescription: Search jobs from verified employers in India and overseas. Filter by trade, location, salary and more. Applying is always free for candidates.
safety.neverCharge: Venkat Sai Global never charges candidates for jobs, applications, interviews or trade tests.
discover.title: Find jobs
discover.description: Search every open job, see why some suit you, and save or apply in a few steps.
filters.title: Filters
filters.sheetDescription: Results update as you choose filters.
filters.salaryHint: Only jobs that show a salary in the same currency and pay period are matched.
filters.salaryNeedsCurrency: Choose a currency and a pay period to filter by salary.
filters.salaryMaxBelowMin: The maximum must be at least the minimum.
results.emptyDescription: New jobs are added as employers are verified. Create a job alert and we will tell you when one fits, or build your skills meanwhile.
results.emptyFilteredDescription: Try fewer filters, a nearby location or a broader keyword. You can also create an alert for this search.
save.errorSave: Could not save this job. Please try again.
save.guardianRequired: A parent or guardian needs to give consent before you can save jobs.
save.errorRemove: Could not remove this job. Please try again.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Please copy it from the address bar.
recommendations.title: Jobs for you
recommendations.description: Based on your profile: skills, preferred roles, location, experience and salary.
recommendations.remote_in_country: Remote work you can do from where you live
recommendations.preferred_location: In a country you prefer to work in
recommendations.overseas_open: Overseas work, which you are open to
recommendations.location_city: In {city}, where you live or want to work
recommendations.relocation: In your country, and you are willing to relocate
recommendations.experience_fit: Your experience fits the {range} asked for
recommendations.experience_close: Your experience is close to the {range} asked for
recommendations.salary_fit: Pays at least your expected salary
recommendations.salary_close: Pays close to your expected salary
detail.notFoundTitle: This job is no longer available
detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been filled, closed or withdrawn by the employer. There are other open jobs you can apply for.
detail.metaDescription: {title} at {employer}. See the full details and apply free on Venkat Sai Global.
detail.externalNotice: This employer takes applications on its own website. Never pay anyone to apply for a job.
detail.alreadyApplied: You have applied for this job
detail.closed: This job is not accepting applications.
detail.noRequirements: The employer has not listed specific requirements.
detail.noTerms: The employer has not added contract details yet. Ask about them before you accept an offer.
detail.overseasNotice: Before you travel for work abroad, check the employer and the recruiting agent, and make sure you have a written contract.
detail.processDefault: After you apply, the hiring team reviews your profile. If you are shortlisted you will be invited to an assessment or interview, and you can follow every step in your People Portal.
detail.freeToApply: Applying is free. You will never be asked to pay to be considered, interviewed or trade-tested for this job.
detail.confidentialBody: The employer has asked Venkat Sai to keep its name confidential for now. Venkat Sai manages this recruitment and has checked the employer. You will learn the employer's name before any interview or offer.
info.verifiedDescription: Venkat Sai has checked the key details of this job with the employer.
info.employerSuppliedDescription: These details come from the employer. Venkat Sai has reviewed the posting but not every detail.
info.pendingReviewDescription: Venkat Sai is still reviewing some details of this job.
agent.title: Recruiting agent
agent.name: Agent name
agent.verifiedDescription: Venkat Sai staff checked this registration certificate and its validity.
agent.checkYourself: You can check any recruiting agent yourself on the Government of India eMigrate portal before you pay or sign anything.
agent.notRecorded: No recruiting agent certificate has been recorded for this overseas job yet. Ask Venkat Sai before you share documents, and never pay a recruitment fee.
privacy.title: Your data and privacy
privacy.body: When you apply, your profile, resume and the documents you choose are shared only with this employer and Venkat Sai, for this job. You can withdraw your application at any time.
alerts.title: Job alerts
alerts.description: Get new jobs that match your searches, daily or weekly, the way you prefer.
alerts.createFromSearch: Create an alert for this search
alerts.formDescription: Leave a field empty to match any value. New alerts only include jobs posted from now on.
alerts.name: Alert name
alerts.nameHint: So you can recognise it in your inbox.
alerts.keywordsHint: Job titles or skills, for example: pipe fitter
alerts.salaryHint: Optional. Matched only against jobs that show a salary in the same currency and pay period.
alerts.channelsHint: WhatsApp and SMS use your verified phone number.
alerts.channelsNoPhone: Verify a phone number in your account to receive alerts by WhatsApp or SMS.
alerts.deleteDescription: You will stop receiving "{name}". You can create it again at any time.
alerts.limitReached: You can have up to {max} job alerts. Delete one to create another.
alerts.emptyDescription: Create an alert and we will send you new jobs that match, so you do not have to keep searching.
saved.title: Saved jobs
saved.description: Jobs you saved to look at later. Apply before they close.
saved.unavailableTitle_one: {count} saved job is no longer open
saved.unavailableTitle_other: {count} saved jobs are no longer open
saved.unavailableBody: They were closed, filled or withdrawn by the employer.
saved.clearDescription_one: {count} job that is no longer open will be removed from your saved list.
saved.clearDescription_other: {count} jobs that are no longer open will be removed from your saved list.
saved.emptyDescription: Tap the bookmark on any job to save it here and come back to it later.
apply.title: Apply: {title}
apply.description: Check what you will share, answer the employer's questions and send your application. It is free.
apply.snapshotDescription: A copy of your profile is shared when you apply. Fill the gaps first for a stronger application.
apply.gapsHint: Your answers on this page are not saved if you leave it.
apply.useProfileResume: Use the resume on my profile
apply.uploadDifferent: Upload a different resume for this job
apply.noProfileResume: You have not added a resume to your profile. You can upload one for this job (optional).
apply.resumeUploadHint: PDF or Word, up to 10 MB.
apply.questionsHint: Answer honestly. Your answers help the hiring team review your application; no single answer rejects you automatically.
apply.coverLetterHint: A few lines on why you are a good fit. Up to 5,000 characters.
apply.consentProfile: I agree to share my profile with {employer} and Venkat Sai Global for this application.
apply.consentDocuments: I agree to share my resume and the documents I marked as shareable with {employer} and Venkat Sai Global for this application.
apply.declaration: I confirm that the information I am sharing is true and complete to the best of my knowledge.
apply.consentFootnote: You can withdraw your application and this consent at any time from your applications.
apply.submittedBody: Your application for {title} has been sent.
apply.whatNext: We will notify you when the status changes. Keep your phone and email handy.
apply.duplicateBody: You can follow this application's progress in your applications.
apply.alreadyAppliedBody: Your application {code} is in progress. You can follow every step from your applications.
apply.unavailableTitle: This job is not taking applications
apply.unavailableBody: It may have closed or been filled. Browse other open jobs or save a search as an alert.
apply.minorTitle: Overseas jobs are open from age 18
apply.minorBody: To keep young people safe, overseas jobs are only open to applicants aged 18 or over. Meanwhile, training and local opportunities can help you get ready.
applications.title: Applications
applications.description: Follow every application, respond to interviews and offers, and send requested documents.
applications.emptyDescription: When you apply for a job, you can follow its progress here.
applications.emptyClosedDescription: Applications that end, are withdrawn or lead to a job appear here.
applications.stageFallback: We will notify you as soon as there is an update.
applications.withdrawDescription: The employer will no longer see your application for {title}, and upcoming interviews will be cancelled. You can apply again later while the job is open.
offers.title: Offer
offers.neverPay: Venkat Sai Global never asks candidates to pay to accept an offer. Report any such request to support.
offers.acceptDescription: The employer and Venkat Sai will be told, and the next steps for joining will start.
offers.signedCopyHint: If the employer asked for a signed copy, upload it here.
offers.declineDescription: The employer will be told. This cannot be undone.
documents.title: Joining and travel
documents.description: Documents and steps requested before you start.
documents.none: No documents are requested from you right now.
documents.submitDescription: Upload the document or add a note. Venkat Sai will check it and let you know.
documents.needFileOrNote: Add a document or a note.
documents.pdot: For overseas jobs, PDOT (Pre-Departure Orientation Training) helps you prepare for work and life abroad.
interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.description: Your interviews and trade tests. Confirm attendance, ask for another time, or add them to your calendar.
interviews.noUpcomingDescription: New invitations will appear here and you will be notified.
interviews.emptyDescription: When an employer invites you to an interview or trade test, it will appear here.
interviews.confirmDescription: The organiser will be told that you plan to attend.
interviews.declineDescription: The organiser will be told that you cannot attend.
interviews.rescheduleDescription: Tell the organiser which days and times suit you.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not load this page. Your information is safe. Please try again.
